app_fee.value: College of Arts & Sciences (which houses all STEM PhD programs) charges a nonrefundable $55 USD application fee.
app_fee.quote: As part of the application form submission, the system will apply a nonrefundable $55 application fee required at this stage to access the supplemental items section.

fee_waiver.value: CAS does not grant individual fee waiver codes; fee waivers are reserved for recruitment event or webinar attendees (CAS Events page).
fee_waiver.quote: Fee waivers are reserved for recruitment event or webinar attendees.

also.quote: Please note that we no longer provide application fee waiver codes on an individual basis.

gre_general.value: CAS standardized test requirements vary by program ('Some may require: Standardized Test Scores'); BEHS and Computational Science & AI explicitly state GRE is not required, while BCaN Neuroscience does not list GRE policy.

also.quote: Some may require: Standardized Test Scores

toefl_min.value: CAS requires a minimum TOEFL score of 100 (also accepts IELTS 7.0, PTE 68, or Duolingo 120).

ielts_min.value: CAS requires a minimum IELTS score of 7.0 (also accepts TOEFL 100, PTE 68, or Duolingo 120).

english_waiver.value: CAS considers automatic English proficiency waivers for Indian citizens who earned a bachelor's degree from an accredited university where English is the sole language of instruction (also for U.S.-based bachelor's/higher degrees).
english_waiver.quote: We can consider automatic waivers for applicants who meet the following criteria: Earned a bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited US-based university or Earned a bachelor's degree from an accredited university where English is the only language of instruction and the applicant is a citizen of one of these countries: ... India

notes: Graduate admissions and policies at American University are set by school/college; all three STEM PhD programs sit in the College of Arts and Sciences (CAS). International visa-sponsored general fallback deadline is May 15 unless a program specifies an earlier deadline (all three STEM PhDs have earlier Fall deadlines of Dec 1 or Jan 15).
